title: Normalize degraded PR-review sub_items and preserve their content in grounding and evidence-tag identity (deferred from #1328)
body:
Deferred from #1328 (its first planning attempt stalled on these questions, with the plan grown to 110k characters).

How should degraded or malformed PR-review `sub_items` (mixed-type lists, non-list values, objects inside them) be normalized? And how should their content be preserved in review grounding (`_validate_review_grounding` / `_joined_text`) and in evidence-tag identity, including distinguishing sibling identities and handling tag swaps?

#1328 deliberately leaves today's behaviour for these unchanged. Pick this up only if real runs show rounds lost to it; attach the failing payload when filing evidence.

-- Anthropic Claude
